mapper.insert: INSERT INTO memory_store_acl (tenant_id, store_id, subject_type, subject_ref, permission, creator_id) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{storeId}, #{subjectType}, #{subjectRef}, #{permission}, #{creatorId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE permission = VALUES(permission), modifier_id = VALUES(creator_id)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM memory_store_acl WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND store_id = #{storeId} AND id = #{id}
